canonical_project: Shared Resource Service Blaenavon data centre
owner: Shared Resource Service / Torfaen County Borough Council partners

location.country: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland

notes: Public sources describe the Shared Resource Service as having a physical Shared Resource Centre in Blaenavon, Torfaen County Borough, housing an on-premise data centre used by the wider Welsh public sector. The 2022 source says partners decided to consolidate ageing on-premise data centres at Newport, Blaenau Gwent and Torfaen into Vantage CWL1; legacy centres were to be decommissioned after migration. Original capacity not disclosed.
